role: Owns the current language and the shared Locale: parses packs' language metadata, reloads the locale's .lang data on every resource reload (en_US plus the current language) and pushes the table into StringTranslate, which the rest of the game reads for translations.

members.name: onResourceManagerReload
members.note: loads locale data and calls StringTranslate.replaceWith

notes: StringTranslate.replaceWith also feeds server-side translation lookups (StatCollector consumers such as villager trade names in GUIs); in agent mode the client is the only consumer and the native engine receives resolved strings in the render-state dump. Not verified beyond that: no in-scope native path needs a translation table. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Language selection and .lang reload; the game runs en_US only and native draws the en_US strings directly.
